scope: GTCRN microphone free listening and noise-safe playback interruption; keep 0.6.2 streaming captions

tests.fullRebuild: All test modules were rerun with --rerun-tasks. Instrumentation compile then caught an ambiguous wildcard import after PlaybackFloor moved to core. Explicit import and Android API compatibility corrections were applied; the complete command above subsequently succeeded (100 tasks, 23 executed, 77 up-to-date).

redGreen: A pass-through denoiser failed real rain attenuation and hop-lookahead tests; actual GTCRN passes.
A SpeechFilter ignoring the enhancement model failed the mixed speech quality comparison; actual enhancement passes.

Original PlaybackFloor muted playback 20 times for the first fixed rain recording despite zero final interruptions. With independent speech evidence both rain recordings yield zero ducks and interruptions.

Linear-resampled quiet playback leaked 3603 nonzero samples through the enhanced pipeline. Residual voice confirmation plus a linear reference in full-band echo matching now produce zero nonzero samples in all 12 cases.

Normal French after rain kept only 45.7 percent of tested opening samples: repeated interruption probes reset the recurrent VAD state. Retaining pending state and the bounded opening lookback passes all 16 interruption cases with at least 97.86 percent opening nonzero retention.
Production LiveDesk initially passed false for enhancement and classified a local processing failure as SERVICE. Routing and typed error handling now pass the integration tests.

Invalid ONNX bytes originally threw an unclassified OrtException. Both voice and enhancement initialization now report AudioProcessingFailure while keeping transport ownership with the caller until construction succeeds.

fixedAudioMetrics.caution: Waveform and retained nonzero samples are not transcription accuracy or an intelligibility guarantee. Controlled synthetic echo and fixture mixing are not natural room or hardware evidence.

lint.note: Dependency update, KTX style and pre-existing caption touch accessibility warnings remain; no claim of a warning-free build.

artifacts.packageInspection: Version 0.6.3 / 6003, minimum API 31. GTCRN, MIT license and source metadata included. ONNX native libraries are under Android lib/ ABI paths only; no desktop DLL, dylib or ai/onnxruntime/native resources. 0.6.2 recovery APK preserved.
artifacts.androidCompatibilityReview: Replaced Optional.orElseThrow() with get(): the local Android API database confirms the zero-argument overload is API 33 while the app supports API 31.
